body:
🤖 Eight original attempts now have audited results and verified HF snapshots. The two additional outcomes separate filtering from build-budget failure:

- Cobrapy returned and entered all four window PRs. Three had no test patch; PR1492 failed the unchanged new-test-function filter. No paired validation or export was reached. Both original smoke checks also timed out, but those flags did not cause the filtering outcome. Eleven model calls cost $0.332655 actual.
- MMseqs2 exhausted 20 bootstrap turns (19 BASH, one INVALID), costing $0.960333 actual. Upstream installed build/Rust dependencies, attempted compilation, hit two build-command timeouts, explicitly launched background make, and later timed out inspecting files. No saved setup/image, PR discovery, runtime parsing or export occurred. Actual compiler parallelism/OOM state was not measured. [Original-command diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/374eca5b05a3bc2664ac6da8e7b35a5baa4e35e4/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/results/soedinglab__MMseqs2-bootstrap-diagnostics.json).

The native 1.5-CPU/six-GiB and independent-control one-CPU/six-GiB caps remain the predeclared comparison settings; no alternate resource/time configuration was tested. No build/parser/filter repair, extra model call or generation retry was added. The pinned source also confirms that native PR validation reuses a repository bootstrap environment across historical base revisions without a per-base dependency reinstall; this explains why a clean newer-revision Matchms smoke did not establish compatibility at PR966's older base. [Pinned-source audit](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/374eca5b05a3bc2664ac6da8e7b35a5baa4e35e4/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/preflight/parser-filter-audit.json).

The eight archived results account for $4.323960 in actual model charges and 12.823019 allocated CPU-hours. Yield remains two Scanpy exports, one independently verified tracked-test task and zero clean verified oracle commands. MNE is active ninth; OHIF follows tenth. Unavailable discovery counts remain unavailable, and whole-cohort cost ratios stay withheld until all ten are accounted for. [Ten-row report with returned/entered and partial-pair counts](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/374eca5b05a3bc2664ac6da8e7b35a5baa4e35e4/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/cohort-report.md) · [Cobrapy archive receipt](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/374eca5b05a3bc2664ac6da8e7b35a5baa4e35e4/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/archives/opencobra__cobrapy-receipt.json) · [MMseqs2 archive receipt](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/374eca5b05a3bc2664ac6da8e7b35a5baa4e35e4/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/archives/soedinglab__MMseqs2-receipt.json).

All eight have complete per-request billing, original terminal readback, fresh anonymous HF object/member hash verification and empty owned Docker resources. Redundant local wrapper/account-usage copies were deleted after verification. Final live resource checks, scientific/conclusion audit, issue closure and removal of remaining task-owned temporary working files are still required. [Closure checklist](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/374eca5b05a3bc2664ac6da8e7b35a5baa4e35e4/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/completion-audit.md).
